prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [反例] 交错跨列 · 共享中间列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "与业务方共同梳理核心流程，输出需求说明书并完成评" spans 2 col × 1 row; "完成核心模块开发与联调，接入统一认证与日志平台" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 2: header "阶段一" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "阶段二" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "阶段三" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 199px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 198px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按需求、开发、测试三个项目类别展示各阶段的工作内容。","reading":"读者先沿行查看同一类别在各阶段的工作，再沿阶段列比较不同类别的安排；跨列单元格表示一项工作覆盖相邻阶段。","groups":["第2至第4列均为阶段列，承担相同的时间组织作用。","第2、3列及第3、4列分别被跨列内容连接，第3列是两项跨列内容共享的中间列。"],"keep_intact":["汉字应保持完整；项目类别和阶段标题尽可能保持在一行。"],"may_wrap":["较长的需求和开发描述可按中文自然换行。","较短的工作名称可利用同行长描述产生的行高换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [40, 40, 78, 40] · table 199×448px · row heights [92, 145, 145, 66] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [55, 40, 55, 48] · table 199×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"三列阶段中间列较宽，两处交错跨列内容都能受益，长描述各占五行，整体高度和阅读节奏优于 r1B。阶段二标题保持一行，需求、开发、测试三行也容易区分。","problems":"项目类别和两个外侧阶段标题逐字竖排；“搭建脚手架”等短内容也被挤成长竖列，削弱了横向扫读。","cause":"第1、2、4列各为40px，扣除21px后只剩19px文字宽度，基本只能容纳一个汉字；第3列78px则为相邻两处跨列内容提供了共同的宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"第1列较宽，类别区域更从容；三个阶段列的宽度差异较小。","problems":"四个标题仍全部换行，两处长描述显著变高，表格比 r1A 高79px。开发行中“搭建脚手架”仍逐字竖排，行内各单元格的文字分布也较零散。","cause":"第1列55px扣除边框和内边距后只有34px，略不足以容纳约35px的“项目”；第3列从78px减至55px，同时压缩了两处跨列单元格，而第2列仍只有40px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"refine-left","widths":[40,48,70,40],"change":"在 r1A 基础上将8px从共享中间列移给阶段一。保持第一处跨列总宽不变，并改善阶段一独立短内容的横向空间；观察第二处跨列多出的换行是否值得。"},{"name":"refine-right","widths":[40,40,70,48],"change":"将8px从共享中间列移给阶段三，保持第二处跨列总宽不变，尝试改善右侧短内容；对照第一处跨列内容的行高变化。"},{"name":"category-priority","widths":[56,40,62,40],"change":"将项目列增至56px，使类别及“项目”标题有机会保持一行；从共享中间列让出宽度，检验类别横向可读性与两处长描述增高之间的取舍。"}]}
